final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type = 'Attività scolastiche'
  AND surface_area >= 180
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C')
  AND mobility >= 51
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: Energy class C or better, per the user's request. Area (180 sqm), capacity (14 people), location in Turin, and proximity to public transport are not energy-efficiency requirements and are not filtered here.
The user wants the building to be located near public transport. The 75th percentile for mobility is 70.93, so the threshold is rounded to 71.

The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 180. The 14-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied. Energy class and public transport proximity are not reference columns and are ignored. Turin is a location and is handled by the Location Agent, so comune_code is not set.
